mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-3m < 0) during the signal period, or SPX posts negative 60-day returns in >50% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by >2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to a hawkish Fed response and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances where UNRATE drops below 4%, or core PCE inflation fails to exceed 3% y/y in the following 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Headline CPI inflation falls below 2% y/y in the 6 months following the signal, or SPX posts positive 60-day returns in >50% of instances where INDPRO y/y growth falls by >2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales, as measured by the year-over-year change in the RSAFS index, signals a weakening consumer that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer confidence (Conference Board index) rises by >5 points in the month following the signal, or SPX posts positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances where RSAFS y/y growth falls by >1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate, combined with a flattening yield curve, signals a hawkish Fed that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 60-day returns in >50% of instances where the trigger condition is met, or the yield curve steepens by >1% in the following 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in payroll employment, as measured by the year-over-year change in the PAYEMS index, signals a strengthening labor market that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Initial jobless claims rise by >10% in the month following the signal, or SPX posts negative 20-day returns in >50% of instances where PAYEMS y/y growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in housing starts, as measured by the year-over-year change in the HOUST index, signals a strengthening housing market that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 30-year mortgage rates rise by >1% in the 6 months following the signal, or SPX posts negative 60-day returns in >50% of instances where HOUST y/y growth exceeds 10%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index, as measured by the year-over-year change in the CPIAUCSL index, signals rising inflation that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Core PCE inflation falls below 2% y/y in the 6 months following the signal, or SPX posts positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL y/y exceeds 3%.
